name: omniscient/omniauth
description: Omniauth: who signs in, and by which factors, under any PHP host - the contracts (accounts, the stores of each proof, the second-factor rule, the host's small duties), the conductor (begin, then verify; the attempt, the result), the methods that need no library (password through symfony/password-hasher, sign-in link, code by e-mail, backup codes, trusted devices in scheb/2fa's cookie format), PSR-14 events and Testing helpers. Passkeys, TOTP and OAuth are packages of their own; the Symfony and Laravel bridges live in omnibridge.

suggest.omniscient/omnibridge: The host contracts: Omnibridge\Contract\Tokens checks a sign-in form's CSRF token; omnibridge/symfony and omnibridge/laravel bridge omniauth to their host
suggest.symfony/cache: A PSR-6 pool or PSR-16 cache for Omniauth\CacheThrottle in plain PHP
